narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Eight is four plus four, so eight works.
<bookmark mark='same'/>Four and four are the same number. The second one must be one more than the first.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That sum is not made of numbers in a row, so it does not count.
